brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Build has two cells (piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full) each with a full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) staged with utensil props (spoon, fork)

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; all parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material. Waterproofing depends on material/process and cannot be verified. Bins are solid (non-drained) which helps contain contents but is not certified waterproof.

Dishwasher safety depends on material, heat resistance and food-safety certification which the configurator does not model. All parts are 3D-printed plastic; heat/chemical resistance cannot be guaranteed from geometry alone.

finish.summary: Two-cell utensil holder built with two solid full-depth bins, capped and joint-locked, staged with spoon/fork to show use. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe cannot be met by geometry alone — requires material choice outside configurator scope.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
